title: FinVerBench: Benchmark Validity and Calibration in Large Language Model Financial Statement Verification

live_model.evidence: FinanceBench [Islam et al., 2023] ... revealed that GPT-4-Turbo with retrieval incorrectly answered or refused 81% of questions (Section 2, related work)
